entries.detail: Rule DF-001 requires diffing a Claude Design handoff bundle (JSX/HTML export, e.g. drill_verify.jsx) against its live-tree counterpart. The three targets contain no such bundle: /Users/scottlydon/Developer/akin/akin/Flows/Social holds only 13 .swift files (AkinAPI.swift, ProfileSwitcherView.swift, QuestionnaireBrowseView.swift, QuestionnaireDetailView.swift, SocialDebugRoute.swift, SubscriptionsView.swift, etc.) with no JSX/HTML present. I grepped REDESIGN_SPECS.md (935 lines) and UX_FEEDBACK.md (310 lines) for "design bundle", "design_bundle", "claude design", and "handoff" and got zero matches; `find ... -iname "*design_bundle*"` under the Social directory also returned nothing. Reading the head of both files shows this is a storyboard/design-tokens.json/SCREENSHOTS_V2 redesign workflow (Main.storyboard, Phase 3.1 implementation, Gate B screenshot verification), not a Claude Design bundle-to-live-tree copy scenario the rule addresses. No offense to report and no PASS to claim, since the rule's precondition (a design bundle exists) is absent from this scope.
entries.rule_title: Copy the design bundle files into the live tree as-is

entries.detail: DF-003 (applies_to: "projects with a Claude Design handoff bundle") audits deviations from a verbatim Claude Design export. I ran `ls` on /Users/scottlydon/Developer/akin/akin/Flows/Social (14 plain .swift files, no _design_bundle or .jsx present), searched for `find ... -iname "*design_bundle*" -o -iname "*claude_design*"` under /Users/scottlydon/Developer/akin (no hits), grepped REDESIGN_SPECS.md and UX_FEEDBACK.md for "design bundle|claude design|_design_bundle|handoff" (no hits), and grepped the session notes file /Users/scottlydon/Developer/GOAL_LOOP_INTERSTICE_HANGS_AND_AKIN_SOCIAL_2026-08-19_NOTES.md for the same terms plus "jsx" (no hits). No Claude Design handoff bundle exists anywhere in the target scope, so there is no verbatim-copy source to compare live files against and no deviation to evaluate.
entries.rule_title: Deviate only for a real, demonstrable user-interface bug

entries.detail: Read rule DF-004 from /Users/scottlydon/Developer/Recurring_goals/Design/Design_Fidelity/rows.csv via python3 csv.DictReader (agent_prompt: forced deviations from a real bug must preserve the exact on-screen experience; no invented rationalizing copy). Constraints forbid building/rendering, so I compared spec text to live source via grep/read instead of Playwright screenshots. Searched REDESIGN_SPECS.md and UX_FEEDBACK.md for 'deviation', 'fallback', 'older format', 'graceful', 'hence', 'legacy' and found exactly one recorded deviation in the whole file, at REDESIGN_SPECS.md:643-646 (AccountSettingsView 'fact' row, outside the Social flow but inside the target file): the design calls for a surface-dim fill on that row, but the page ground is also surface-dim so the fill would vanish; the entry states the live tree keeps 'surface' instead and preserves non-navigability via the design's other four signals (inverted hierarchy, no chevron, no press state, isUserInteractionEnabled=false, .staticText). This is a properly disclosed, reasoned deviation with no added rationalizing banner or 'older format' style text, matching the rule's requirement. I also grepped /Users/scottlydon/Developer/akin/akin/Flows/Social/*.swift for 'fallback|older format|legacy|TODO|FIXME|hence|graceful' with zero hits, and cross-checked the Social-specific spec strings ('Not rated yet', 'Author not shown', 'No questionnaires here yet', 'No answers yet', 'Add answers', '<name> copy') against QuestionnaireBrowseView.swift, QuestionnaireBrowseViewModel.swift, QuestionnaireDetailViewModel.swift, ProfileSwitcherView.swift, and ProfileSwitcherViewModel.swift; all match the spec verbatim. QuestionnaireDetailViewModel.swift:74 adds a third 'Readers see: no name, and your followers are told it was you' string beyond the spec's two quoted examples, but this implements the full three-value AuthorVisibility enum rather than being a bug-forced deviation, and REDESIGN_SPECS.md nowhere marks it as a deviation, so it falls outside this rule's scope (forced deviations preserving on-screen experience, not general spec/code string coverage). This rule addresses code artifacts, not session/transcript behavior, so the session notes file was not needed for DF-004.
entries.rule_title: A forced deviation preserves the exact on-screen experience

entries.detail: Rule DF-005 applies only to "projects with a Claude Design handoff bundle" and its detection method requires diffing live-tree strings against that design bundle. I searched the target scope for a bundle: `find /Users/scottlydon/Developer/akin -iname "*design_bundle*" -o -iname "*claude_design*"` returned nothing, and `grep -ni "design bundle|claude design|_design_bundle|\.dc\.html" REDESIGN_SPECS.md UX_FEEDBACK.md` found no matches. REDESIGN_SPECS.md and UX_FEEDBACK.md are a hand-authored redesign spec tied to `design-tokens.json`/`BRAND_GUIDELINES.md`, not a Claude Design .dc.html artboard export. With no design bundle present, there is no reference tree to diff Social's user-visible strings against. I did additionally scan /Users/scottlydon/Developer/akin/akin/Flows/Social/*.swift for rationalizing/fallback copy patterns (hence, older format, fallback, graceful fallback, phase completed, unavailable, could not, placeholder) and found only two ordinary error-description strings in AkinAPI.swift lines 37-38 ("Could not reach the server...", "The server's reply could not be read...") which describe real network/parse failures, not stale-status coping text, so this would not have been a finding even if the rule applied.
entries.rule_title: Never add rationalizing copy the design did not have

The targets (Social flow Swift code, REDESIGN_SPECS.md, and UX_FEEDBACK.md) contain no Claude Design handoff bundle, no .dc.html file, and no _design_bundle directory.
